chapter.verse: Saul in Stefen sih nading a thukim hi. Tua lai takin Jerusalem khua-ah a om pawlpite nakpi-in bawlsia uh a, sawltakte sim loh thu-um midangte khempeuh in Judah gam leh Samaria gam mun khempeuh ah a kithehthang uh hi.
Thu a zahtakte in Stefen a vui uh a, ama hangin nakpi-in a kap uh hi.
Saul a hih leh, pawlpite bawlsia a, inn khempeuh ah a lut khit ciangin pasal leh numeite kaikhia a, thong sungah a khum hi.
Tua ahih ciangin gam khempeuh ah a kithehthang mite a vak kawikawi uh a, thu a hilh uh hi.
Filip in Samaria khua-ah pai-in Khazih thu a gen hi.
Mihonte in a za uh a, Filip hih nalamdangte a muh ciangin tua thu lungsim kikhatin a ngai ciat uh hi.
Bang hang hiam i cih leh, dawivei mi tampite pan dawite in nakpi-in kiko-in a pusuak uh hi. A pum langkhat a si mi leh khebai mi tampi in damna a ngah uh hi.
Tua khua sungah lungdamna tampi a piang hi.
Simon min nei mi khat in tua khua sungah mitphial dawi bawlin, “Kei zong milian khat ka hi hi,” ci-in Samaria mite lamdang a sasak ngei hi.
A neu a lian a om khempeuh in, “Hih mi in Lian kici Pasian’ vangliatna mah hi,” ci-in ama thu a ngai uh hi.
Amah in mitphial bawlin, sawt veipi mite lamdang sasak ahih ciangin amaute in a thu a ngai uh hi.
Filip in Pasian’ Gam leh Zeisu Khazih’ minin Lungdamna Thu gen a, tua mite in a up uh ciangin numeite leh pasalte a kibaptaiz uh hi.
Simon in zong um a, a kibaptaiz khit ciangin Filip kiangah om a, nalamdang lian leh lim a bawl a muh ciangin lamdang a sa hi.
Samaria khuapihte in Pasian’ thu a mang uh a, Jerusalem khua-ah a om sawltakte in a zak uh ciangin Piter leh Johan a sawl uh hi.
Tuate a tun’ uh ciangin amaute in Kha Siangtho a ngah nadingun amaute ading thu a ngetsak uh hi.
Bang hang hiam i cih leh, Topa Zeisu’ min tawh a kibaptaiz khit uh hangin Kha Siangtho in khat beek tungah a tung nai kei hi.
Amaute in tua mite tungah a khut uh a ngak khit uh ciangin Kha Siangtho a ngah uh hi.
Sawltakte in khut a ngak uh ciangin Kha Siangtho kipia Simon in a muh ciangin,
“Keima khut a tungah ka ngaksate in Kha Siangtho a ngah nadingin kei zong thu hong pia in,” ci-in dangka a lui hi.
Piter in, “Pasian’ hehpihna dangka tawh kilei thei hi cih ngaihsun na hih ciangin nang tawh na dangka siakhawm ta hen.
Nang in hih thu tawh na kikum na kituak kei hi. Bang hang hiam na cih leh, nangma lungsim in Pasian mai-ah a man kei hi.
Tua ahih ciangin na khialhna na kisikkik in la, na lungsim ngaihsutna a kimaisak nadingin Pasian kiangah thu na ngen in.
Bang hang hiam na cih leh, nangmah in a kha sinkha na nei a, mawhna kikhihna na thuak hi cih ka thei hi,” a ci hi.
Simon in, “Na thupiak khat beek keima tungah a tun’ loh nadingin Pasian kiangah thu hong ngetsak in,” a ci hi.
Amaute in teci a pang uh a, Topa’ thu a hilh khit uh ciangin Jerusalem khuapi-ah a ciah uh a, Samaria mite khua tampi sungah Lungdamna Thu a hilh uh hi.
Pasian’ vantungmi khat in Filip kiangah, “Nang tho in la, Jerusalem khua panin Gaza khua lam paina khanglam pai in,” ci-in a gen mah bangin Filip tho a, a pai hi. Tua mun in gamlak ahi hi.
Tua lai takin Ethiopia gam a uk Kandake kumpinu nuai-ah a vanglian, a vaihawm mang, ama sum khempeuh a uk, Ethiopia mi khat in Pasian bia dingin Jerusalem khua-ah a pai khit ciangin,
a ciahkik lai takin a leeng tungah tuangin kamsangpa Isaiah Lai Siangtho a sim hi.
Kha Siangtho in, “Tua leeng va nai in la, beel in,” ci-in Filip kiangah thu a piak ciangin Filip in ama kiangah tai a,
kamsangpa Isaiah’ lai a sim za a, “Na simna thu na thei hiam?” ci-in a dong hi.
Tua mangpa in, “Hong hilh a om kei leh, bang ci theih ding ka hi hiam?” a cih ciangin, Filip in amah tawh kahto a, tukhawm dingin mangpa in a ngen hi.
Lai Siangtho a simna in: “Thah dinga a kipaipih tuu bangin amah kipaipih hi. Tuuno in a mul mette mai-ah a ham loh banginah, Amah in zong a kam a ka kei hi.
A kilungnemsak lai takin midangte in ama tungah thu a khen uh hi. Ama hin’na leitungah kilakhia ahih ciangin, Ama suante kua in a lak ding hiam?” cih ahi hi.
Mangpa in, “Kamsangpa in a kua thu a gen hiam? Amah a kicihnopna-a a gen hiam? Ahih kei leh, midang cihnopna-a a gen hiam?” ci-in Filip kiangah a dong hi.
Filip in kam ka a, tua Lai Siangtho pan akipan Zeisu thu a gen hi.
Lampi a pai lai takun tui omna-ah a tung uh a,

Mangpa in, “Tui a om hi. Keimah kibaptaiz loh nadingin bang thu in hong kham ahi hiam?” a ci hi. Filip in, “Na lungsim khempeuh tawh na up leh ahi thei hi,” a ci hi; Mangpa in zong, ‘Zeisu Khazih in Pasian’ Tapa ahihna thu ka um hi,’ ci-in a pulak ciangin,
Mangpa in leeng khawlsak a, Filip leh Mangpa a nihun tui sungah a pai uh a, Filip in a baptaiz hi.
Tui sung pan a kahtoh khit ciangin Kha Siangtho in Filip lakhia a, Mangpa in a nung ciangin Filip a mu nawn kei hi; lungdam mahmahin lam a paikik hi.
Ahih hangin Filip Azotas khua-ah kimu hi. Tua khua panin Kaisaria khua dongin khua khempeuh ah pai kawikawi-in Lungdamna Thu a hilh hi.
